remaining_risks: Production readiness restrictions from PR #62 remain; no production deployment performed.
Impressions count server-issued reservations, not verified five-second views.
Hostile clients may bypass presentation; advertisements are not financial authorization.
Background tabs may delay automatic dismissal until JS resumes.
Historic impressions require an operational retention policy.
External destinations require administrator review; voluntary navigation exposes ordinary connection metadata, but no account data or referrer.
Two platform-specific non-POSIX variants cannot run on Linux.
Responsive mobile tests use Chromium; physical iOS/Safari was not tested.
